title: The Economics of Nutrient Pollution from Agriculture
abstract: Nutrient pollution from agricultural sources, coming primarily from fertilization of row crops and manure from livestock operations, affects ecological health in the United States through water and air pollution. We summarize data trends on commercial fertilizer use, manure, cropland, and concentrations of nitrogen and phosphorus in waterways. We present data indicating that fertilizer applications per acre of US cropland exhibit an upward trend, with a strong spatial correlation between agricultural intensification and nutrient contents in waterbodies. While biophysical science has advanced our understanding of how nutrient pollutants affect the functioning of physical ecosystems, economic research has quantified only some of the economic damages related to losses in ecosystem services due to nutrient pollution. Our summary of this work indicates that quantification is incomplete and does not yet provide full characterization of these damages across the country. We summarize key available damage estimates and the limited evidence on cost-effective policy design. We conclude by identifying important yet understudied areas, including a focus on contaminated drinking water sources, health damages from nutrient pollution, and the need for holistic estimates of the costs of the externalities from pollution, where new research efforts will greatly benefit society.
abstract_zh: 农业来源的养分污染主要来自大田作物的施肥和畜牧养殖场的粪便，通过水体和空气污染影响美国的生态健康。我们总结了商品化肥使用、粪便、耕地以及水体中氮和磷浓度的数据趋势。数据表明，美国每英亩耕地的化肥施用量呈上升趋势，且农业集约化与水体养分含量之间存在很强的空间相关性。尽管生物物理科学已加深了我们对养分污染物如何影响自然生态系统功能的理解，但经济学研究仅量化了养分污染导致的生态系统服务损失所引发的部分经济损害。我们对这些工作的总结表明，量化工作尚不完整，尚未全面刻画全国范围内的这些损害。我们总结了现有的主要损害估计，以及关于具有成本效益的政策设计的有限证据。最后，我们指出了重要但研究不足的领域，包括关注受污染的饮用水源、养分污染导致的健康损害，以及对污染外部性成本进行整体估算的需要；这些新的研究努力将极大地造福社会。

title: Valuing Water Quality in the United States Using a National Dataset on Property Values
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: High-quality water resources provide a wide range of benefits, but the value of water quality is often not fully represented in environmental policy decisions, due in large part to an absence of water quality valuation estimates at large, policy relevant scales. Using data on property values with nationwide coverage across the contiguous United States, we estimate the benefits of lake water quality as measured through capitalization in housing markets. We find compelling evidence that homeowners place a premium on improved water quality. This premium is largest for lakefront property and decays with distance from the waterbody. In aggregate, we estimate that 10% improvement of water quality for the contiguous United States has a value of $6 to 9 billion to property owners. This study provides credible evidence for policymakers to incorporate lake water quality value estimates in environmental decision-making.
abstract_zh: 优质水资源能带来广泛的效益，但由于缺乏大尺度、与政策相关的水质价值估计，水质价值在环境政策决策中往往未能得到充分体现。利用覆盖美国本土全境的房产价值数据，我们通过房屋市场的资本化估算了湖泊水质的效益。我们发现了有力证据表明，房主对水质改善存在溢价。这一溢价对滨湖房产最大，并随与水体距离的增加而递减。总体而言，我们估计美国本土水质改善10%对房产所有者的价值为60亿至90亿美元。本研究为政策制定者将湖泊水质价值估计纳入环境决策提供了可信的证据。

title: Contributions of Women at the Intersection of Agricultural Economics and Environmental and Natural Resource Economics
abstract: This paper discusses contributions that women at the intersection of agricultural economics and environmental and resource economics have made over the past several decades to their profession, through both research and leadership. We highlight research contributions in the following areas: land use and conservation, non‐market valuation, environmental policy design, and climate and energy economics. Key examples of leadership within the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association and the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists are also discussed. We conclude with some brief personal reflections regarding our experience working at this interface.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了在农业经济学与环境和资源经济学交叉领域工作的女性，在过去数十年中通过研究和领导工作为该专业所做的贡献。我们重点介绍了以下领域的研究贡献：土地利用与保护、非市场价值评估、环境政策设计，以及气候与能源经济学。文中还讨论了她们在美国农业与应用经济学协会以及环境与资源经济学家协会中的重要领导工作。最后，我们简要分享了自己在这一交叉领域工作的个人感悟。

title: A Water Rule that Turns a Blind Eye to Transboundary Pollution
Integrated assessment modeling reveals near-channel management as cost-effective to improve water quality in agricultural watersheds
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Water quality is severely degraded in landscapes cultivated for intensive corn and soybean production. Current water quality policy focuses on reducing nutrient and sediment losses from agricultural fields, yet recent studies have highlighted important roles of near-channel areas as sources of sediment and sinks for nitrogen. We developed an integrated modeling approach to assess water quality cost-effectiveness tradeoffs for watershed management scenarios that include a wide range of both field and near-channel management actions, yielding estimates of reductions in sediment and nitrate loads and associated costs for alternative management actions. Our results indicate that near-channel management, most notably fluvial wetland restoration, was most effective for achieving long-standing policy goals for sediment and nitrate reduction.
abstract_zh: 在集约化种植玉米和大豆的景观中，水质严重退化。当前的水质政策侧重于减少农田的养分和泥沙流失，然而近期研究强调了近河道区域作为泥沙来源和氮汇的重要作用。我们开发了一种综合建模方法，用以评估包含广泛的田间和近河道管理措施的流域管理情景的水质成本效益权衡，从而得出各种替代管理措施下泥沙和硝酸盐负荷的削减量及相关成本。我们的结果表明，近河道管理，尤其是河漫滩湿地恢复，在实现长期以来的泥沙和硝酸盐减排政策目标方面最为有效。

title: A Midwest USA Perspective on Von Cossel et al.’s Prospects of Bioenergy Cropping Systems for a More Social-Ecologically Sound Bioeconomy
abstract: Bioenergy cropping systems afford the prospect to provide a more socially and ecologically sustainable bioeconomy. By creating opportunities to diversify agroecosystems, bioenergy crops can be used to fulfill multiple functions in addition to providing more environmentally benign fuels. Bioenergy crops can be assembled into cropping systems that provide both food and energy and which also provide cleaner water, improved soil quality, increased carbon sequestration, and increased biological diversity. In so doing, they improve the resilience of agroecosystems and reduce risks associated with climate change. Beyond the farmgate, bioenergy crops can improve the economic prospects of rural communities by creating new jobs and providing opportunities for local investment.
abstract_zh: 生物能源种植系统为实现更具社会和生态可持续性的生物经济提供了可能。通过为农业生态系统的多样化创造机会，生物能源作物除了提供更环保的燃料之外，还可以承担多种功能。生物能源作物可以组合成既提供粮食和能源、又提供更清洁水源、改善土壤质量、增加碳封存和提高生物多样性的种植系统。这样一来，它们提高了农业生态系统的韧性，并降低了与气候变化相关的风险。超出农场大门之外，生物能源作物还能通过创造新的就业机会和为当地投资提供机会，改善农村社区的经济前景。

title: Conservation Co-Benefits from Air Pollution Regulation: Evidence from Birds
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Massive wildlife losses over the past 50 years have brought new urgency to identifying both the drivers of population decline and potential solutions. We provide the first large-scale evidence that air pollution, specifically ozone, is associated with declines in bird abundance in the United States. We show that an air pollution regulation limiting ozone precursors emissions has delivered substantial benefits to bird conservation. Our estimates imply that air quality improvements over the past four decades have stemmed the decline in bird populations, averting the loss of 1.5 billion birds, approximately 20 percent of current totals. Our results highlight that in addition to protecting human health, air pollution regulations have previously unrecognized and unquantified conservation co-benefits.
abstract_zh: 过去50年间，野生动物大规模减少，这使人们迫切需要识别种群下降的驱动因素以及潜在的解决方案。我们首次提供了大规模证据，表明空气污染，特别是臭氧，与美国鸟类数量的减少有关。我们表明，限制臭氧前体物排放的一项空气污染法规为鸟类保护带来了显著效益。我们的估计表明，过去四十年的空气质量改善遏制了鸟类种群的下降，避免了15亿只鸟类的损失，约占当前总量的20%。我们的结果表明，空气污染法规除了保护人类健康之外，还具有此前未被认识和未被量化的保护协同效益。

title: The Low but Uncertain Measured Benefits of US Water Quality Policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: US investment to decrease pollution in rivers, lakes, and other surface waters has exceeded $1.9 trillion since 1960, and has also exceeded the cost of most other US environmental initiatives. These investments come both from the 1972 Clean Water Act and the largely voluntary efforts to control pollution from agriculture and urban runoff. This paper reviews the methods and conclusions of about 20 recent evaluations of these policies. Surprisingly, most analyses estimate that these policies’ benefits are much smaller than their costs; the benefit–cost ratio from the median study is 0.37. However, existing evidence is limited and undercounts many types of benefits. We conclude that it is unclear whether many of these regulations truly fail a benefit–cost test or whether existing evidence understates their net benefits; we also describe specific questions that when answered would help eliminate this uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自1960年以来，美国用于减少河流、湖泊及其他地表水污染的投资已超过1.9万亿美元，也超过了美国大多数其他环境举措的成本。这些投资既来自1972年《清洁水法》，也来自主要为自愿性质的农业及城市径流污染控制努力。本文回顾了约20项近期针对这些政策所作评估的方法与结论。令人意外的是，大多数分析估计，这些政策的收益远小于其成本；中位数研究的收益—成本比仅为0.37。然而，现有证据十分有限，且低估了许多类型的收益。我们的结论是：目前尚不清楚这些法规中的许多是否真的未能通过收益—成本检验，抑或现有证据低估了其净收益；我们也描述了若能回答便有助于消除这一不确定性的具体问题。

title: How are Scope and Adding up Relevant for Benefits Transfer?
Integrated Assessment Models of the Food, Energy, and Water Nexus: A Review and an Outline of Research Needs
abstract: Food, energy, and water (FEW) systems play a fundamental role in determining societal health and economic well-being. However, current and expected changes in climate, population, and land use place these systems under considerable stress. To improve policies that target these challenges, this review highlights the need for integrating biophysical and economic models of the FEW nexus. We discuss advancements in modeling individual components that comprise this system and outline fundamental research needs for these individual areas as well as for model integration. Though great strides have been made in individual and integrated modeling, we nevertheless find a considerable need for improved integration of economic decision-making with biophysical models. We also highlight a need for improved model validation.
abstract_zh: 粮食、能源和水（FEW）系统在决定社会健康和经济福祉方面发挥着根本性作用。然而，当前和预期的气候、人口及土地利用变化使这些系统承受着巨大压力。为改进针对这些挑战的政策，本综述强调需要整合FEW关联系统的生物物理模型与经济模型。我们讨论了构成该系统的各个组成部分建模的进展，概述了这些单个领域以及模型整合方面的基本研究需求。尽管单个模型和综合模型都已取得长足进展，但我们仍然发现，亟需改进经济决策与生物物理模型的整合。我们还强调需要改进模型验证。

title: A Refined Regional Modeling Approach for the Corn Belt: Recommendations for Large-Scale Integrated Modeling

Resilient Provision of Ecosystem Services from Agricultural Landscapes: Tradeoffs involving Means and Variances of Water Quality Improvements
abstract: We assess the trade‐offs and synergies involved in reducing agriculture‐generated nutrient loads with different levels of resilience. We optimize the selection of least‐cost patterns of agricultural conservation practices for both the expected performance of the conservation actions and its variance. Securing nutrient loads with a higher level of resilience is costly, with marginal costs of resilience generally declining with lower loads. We find that the main trade‐off dimension is between cost of conservation investments and ecosystem service objectives, as opposed to pronounced mean‐variance or between‐nutrient objectives trade‐offs. We find relative synergies in agricultural conservation investments aimed at nutrient reductions.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了在不同韧性水平下减少农业产生的养分负荷所涉及的权衡与协同效应。我们针对保护行动的预期绩效及其方差，优化选择了成本最低的农业保护措施组合。将养分负荷控制在更高的韧性水平上成本高昂，且韧性的边际成本通常随负荷降低而下降。我们发现，主要的权衡维度在于保护投资成本与生态系统服务目标之间，而非显著的均值—方差权衡或不同养分目标之间的权衡。我们发现，旨在减少养分的农业保护投资存在相对的协同效应。

title: The Optimality of Using Marginal Land for Bioenergy Crops: Tradeoffs between Food, Fuel, and Environmental Services
abstract: We assess empirically how agricultural lands should be used to produce the highest valued outputs, which include food, energy, and environmental goods and services. We explore efficiency tradeoffs associated with allocating land between food and bioenergy and use a set of market prices and nonmarket environmental values to value the outputs produced by those crops. We also examine the degree to which using marginal land for energy crops is an approximately optimal rule. Our empirical results for an agricultural watershed in Iowa show that planting energy crops on marginal land is not likely to yield the highest valued output.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实证方法评估农业用地应如何利用，以生产价值最高的产出，包括粮食、能源以及环境产品和服务。我们探讨了在粮食与生物能源之间分配土地所涉及的效率权衡，并使用一套市场价格和非市场环境价值对这些作物所生产的产出进行估价。我们还考察了将边际土地用于能源作物在多大程度上是近似最优的规则。我们在爱荷华州一个农业流域的实证结果表明，在边际土地上种植能源作物不太可能产出价值最高的产出。

title: Recreational Demand for Clean Water: Evidence from Geotagged Photographs by Visitors to Lakes
venue: Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment
abstract: More than 41 000 water bodies are listed as impaired by the US Environmental Protection Agency under the Clean Water Act. Implementation and enforcement of regulations designed to address these impairments can be costly, raising questions about the value of the public benefits derived from improved surface water quality. Here, we assess the recreational value of changes in water quality using freely available geotagged photographs, taken by members of the public, as a proxy for recreational visits to lakes. We found that improved water clarity is associated with increased numbers of visits to lakes and that lake users were willing to incur greater costs to visit clearer lakes. Lake users were willing to travel 56 minutes farther (equivalent to US$22 in travel costs) for every one‐meter increase in water clarity in Minnesota and Iowa lakes, when controlling for other lake attributes. Our approach demonstrates the potential for social‐media data to inform social–ecological research, including assessment of the recreational benefits of improvements in water quality.
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护局根据《清洁水法》列出了超过41000个受损水体。为解决这些损害而制定和执行的法规的实施与执法成本可能很高，这引发了人们对改善地表水质所带来的公共效益价值的质疑。在此，我们利用公众免费拍摄的带有地理标签的照片作为湖泊休闲访问的代理变量，评估水质变化的休闲价值。我们发现，水体清澈度的提高与湖泊访问次数的增加相关，并且湖泊使用者愿意为前往更清澈的湖泊而承担更高的成本。在控制其他湖泊特征的情况下，明尼苏达州和爱荷华州湖泊的水体清澈度每增加一米，湖泊使用者愿意多行驶56分钟（相当于22美元的交通成本）。我们的方法表明，社交媒体数据具有为社会—生态研究提供信息的潜力，包括评估水质改善的休闲效益。

title: Understanding Behavioral Explanations of the WTP-WTA Divergence through a Neoclassical Lens: Implications for Environmental Policy
abstract: The often observed empirical divergence between WTA and WTP measures of welfare change continues to be a topic of interest to both theoretical and applied economists. The divergence has particularly important implications for environmental policy. In this article, we review behavioral and other explanations of the disparity, with a focus on their connections to neoclassical welfare theory, and evaluate the empirical evidence of these explanations through the same lens. Some explanations of the disparity are consistent with neoclassical models, and some are not. Likewise, some imply that the divergences are attributed to underlying preferences (neoclassical or not), whereas others suggest that the divergences are due to elicitation methods, cognitive limitations, or other non-preference-related reasons. We argue that the source of the divergence can inform the choice of which measure, WTP or WTA, to use in a given empirical application.
abstract_zh: 在福利变化的衡量中，WTA与WTP之间经常被观察到的实证差异，始终是理论经济学家和应用经济学家共同关注的话题。这种差异对环境政策具有特别重要的意义。在本文中，我们回顾了对这一差异的行为学解释及其他解释，重点关注它们与新古典福利理论之间的联系，并以同样的视角评估这些解释的实证证据。一些解释与新古典模型相一致，另一些则不然。同样，一些解释认为这种差异归因于潜在偏好（新古典偏好或非新古典偏好），而另一些则认为这种差异源于测度方法、认知局限或其他与偏好无关的原因。我们认为，差异的来源可以为在特定实证应用中选择使用WTP还是WTA提供依据。

title: A Comparison of Value Elicitation Question Formats in Multiple-Good Contingent Valuation
An Improved Reverse Auction for Addressing Water Quality in Agricultural Watersheds Using Coupled Simulation-Optimization Models
Cost-Effective Targeting of Conservation Investments to Reduce the Northern Gulf of Mexico Hypoxic Zone
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Hypoxic (low-oxygen) zones threaten an increasing number of marine ecosystems. Hypoxia in the Gulf of Mexico is the second largest in the world. The United States has a policy goal of reducing the average zone to 5,000 km
2
. Reductions in nutrients from cropland in the Mississippi-Atchafalaya River Basin are needed to achieve this goal. We use an integrated assessment model coupled with optimization to identify the cost-effective locations to target cropland conservation investments across the Basin’s 550 agricultural subwatersheds and to identify the nature of tradeoffs between hypoxia and costs of conservation investments. Targeted conservation practice investments are estimated to achieve the hypoxia reduction goal at the cost of $2.7 billion annually.
abstract_zh: 缺氧（低氧）区威胁着越来越多的海洋生态系统。墨西哥湾的缺氧区是世界第二大缺氧区。美国的政策目标是将该区域的平均面积减少到5,000 km²。需要减少密西西比—阿查法拉亚河流域耕地的养分流失，以实现这一目标。我们使用与优化相结合的综合评估模型，以确定在该流域550个农业子流域中进行耕地保护投资的成本效益最高的地点，并确定缺氧减少与保护投资成本之间权衡的性质。估计通过有针对性的保护措施投资，可以以每年27亿美元的成本实现缺氧减少目标。

title: Reversing the Property Rights: Practice-Based Approaches for Controlling Agricultural Nonpoint-Source Water Pollution When Emissions Aggregate Nonlinearly
Surface Water Quality and Cropping Systems Sustainability under a Changing Climate in the Upper Mississippi River Basin
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Agricultural nonpoint source pollution is the main source of nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) in the intensely row-cropped Upper Mississippi River Basin (UMRB) stream system and is considered the primary cause of the northern Gulf of Mexico hypoxic zone according to the US Environmental Protection Agency. A point of crucial importance in this region is therefore how intensive corn (Zea mays L.)-based cropping systems for food and fuel production can be sustainable and coexist with a healthy water environment, not only under existing climate conditions but also under a changed climate in the future. To address this issue, a UMRB integrated modeling system has been built with a greatly refined 12-digit subbasin structure based on the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT) water quality model, which is capable of estimating landscape and in-stream water and pollutant yields in response to a wide array of alternative cropping and/or management strategies and climatic conditions. The effects of the following four agricultural management scenarios on crop production and pollutant loads exported from the cropland of the UMRB to streams and rivers were evaluated: (1) expansion of continuous corn across the entire basin, (2) adoption of no-till on all corn and soybean (Glycine max L.) fields in the region, (3) substitution of the traditional continuous corn and corn–soybean rotations with an extended five-year rotation consisting of corn, soybean, and three years of alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.), and (4) implementation of a winter cover crop within the baseline rotations. The effects of each management scenario were evaluated both for current climate and a projected midcentury (2046 to 2065) climate from a General Circulation Model (GCM). All four scenarios behaved similarly under the historical and future climate, generally resulting in reduced erosion and nutrient loadings to surface water bodies compared to the baseline agricultural management. Continuous corn was the only scenario which resulted in increased N pollution while no-till was the most environmentally effective and able to sustain production at almost the same levels. Rye (Secale cereale L.) cover crop within the fallow period was also effective in reducing erosion and both sediment-bound and soluble forms of nutrients. The results indicated that alternative management practices could reduce sediment, N, and P exports from UMRB cropland by up to 50% without significantly affecting yields. Results for the climate change scenario showed that the effectiveness of the management scenarios was strongly linked to the reduced water availability predicted under the future climate, which assisted in mitigating pollutant transport, although with a small loss of production.
abstract_zh: 农业面源污染是美国上密西西比河流域（UMRB）河流系统中氮（N）和磷（P）的主要来源，美国环境保护局认为这也是墨西哥湾北部缺氧区的主要成因。因此，该地区的一个至关重要的问题是，以玉米（Zea mays L.）为基础的集约化种植系统在满足粮食和燃料生产需求的同时，如何能够实现可持续，并与健康的水环境共存，不仅在当前气候条件下如此，在未来气候变化的情境下也是如此。为解决这一问题，我们基于土壤和水评估工具（SWAT）水质模型，构建了一个具有精细12位子流域结构的UMRB综合建模系统，该系统能够估算在各种替代种植和/或管理策略及气候条件下的景观和河道水量与污染物产量。我们评估了以下四种农业管理情景对作物生产以及从UMRB耕地输出至溪流和河流的污染物负荷的影响：（1）在整个流域扩大连作玉米；（2）在该地区所有玉米和大豆（Glycine max L.）田块采用免耕；（3）以包括玉米、大豆和三年苜蓿（Medicago sativa L.）的五年期延长轮作，替代传统的连作玉米和玉米—大豆轮作；（4）在基准轮作中实施冬季覆盖作物。我们分别在当前气候和由一个环流模式（GCM）得出的预测中期（2046至2065年）气候条件下评估了每种管理情景的效果。四种情景在历史气候和未来气候下的表现总体相似，相较于基准农业管理，它们普遍减少了侵蚀以及养分向地表水体的输入。连作玉米是唯一导致氮污染增加的情景，而免耕在环境效果上最为有效，并且能够将产量维持在几乎相同的水平。休耕期间种植黑麦（Secale cereale L.）作为覆盖作物，同样有效减少了侵蚀以及泥沙结合态和可溶态养分的流失。结果表明，替代管理措施可以在基本不显著影响产量的情况下，将UMRB耕地的泥沙、氮和磷输出减少多达50%。气候变化情景的结果表明，管理情景的有效性与未来气候下预测的水分可利用性降低密切相关，这有助于减缓污染物迁移，尽管产量会有少量损失。

title: A Dynamic Explanation of the Willingness to Pay and Willingness to Accept Disparity
The Potential for Agricultural Land Use Change to Reduce Flood Risk in a Large Watershed
abstract: Effects of agricultural land management practices on surface runoff are evident at local scales, but evidence for watershed-scale impacts is limited. In this study, we used the Soil and Water Assessment Tool model to assess changes in downstream flood risks under different land uses for the large, intensely agricultural, Raccoon River watershed in Iowa. We first developed a baseline model for flood risk based on current land use and typical weather patterns and then simulated the effects of varying levels of increased perennials on the landscape under the same weather patterns. Results suggest that land use changes in the Raccoon River could reduce the likelihood of flood events, decreasing both the number of flood events and the frequency of severe floods. The duration of flood events were not substantially affected by land use change in our assessment. The greatest flood risk reduction was associated with converting all cropland to perennial vegetation, but we found that converting half of the land to perennial vegetation or extended rotations (and leaving the remaining area in cropland) could also have major effects on reducing downstream flooding potential. We discuss the potential costs of adopting the land use change in the watershed to illustrate the scale of subsidies required to induce large-scale conversion to perennially based systems needed for flood risk reduction. abstract_zh: 农业土地管理措施对地表径流的影响在局地尺度上显而易见，但关于流域尺度影响的证据有限。在本研究中，我们使用土壤和水评估工具模型，评估了爱荷华州浣熊河流域（一个大型、农业高度集约化的流域）在不同土地利用方式下下游洪水风险的变化。我们首先基于当前土地利用和典型天气模式建立了洪水风险基准模型，然后在相同天气模式下模拟了景观中多年生植被增加到不同水平的效果。结果表明，浣熊河流域的土地利用变化可以降低洪水事件发生的可能性，既减少洪水事件的次数，也降低严重洪水的频率。在我们的评估中，洪水事件的持续时间并未受到土地利用变化的显著影响。最大的洪水风险降低来自于将全部耕地转为多年生植被，但我们发现，将一半土地转为多年生植被或实施延长轮作（并保留其余面积为耕地），也可以对降低下游洪水潜在风险产生重大影响。我们讨论了在流域内采用土地利用变化的潜在成本，以说明为促使大规模转向降低洪水风险所需的多年生植被系统所需补贴的规模。版权所有 © 2013 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

title: Environmental Economics: How Agricultural Economists Helped Advance the Field
venue: American Journal of Agricultural Economics, special centennial
abstract: In this essay we examine the coevolution and cross‐fertilization of environmental and agricultural economics over the past century. We discuss the key role that agricultural economists have played in the intellectual development of environmental economics. We focus on three primary contributions: incentive design, nonmarket valuation, and joint determination. The nature of these contributions is illustrated using specific examples from the literature. Agricultural economists’ tendency to focus on applied problems has enriched and broadened both the academic debates and the policy advice provided by economists.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们考察了过去一个世纪环境经济学与农业经济学的共同演进及相互促进。我们讨论了农业经济学家在环境经济学智识发展中所发挥的关键作用。我们重点关注三方面的主要贡献：激励设计、非市场价值评估以及联合决定。这些贡献的性质通过文献中的具体例子加以说明。农业经济学家专注于应用问题的倾向，丰富并拓宽了经济学界的学术争论和政策建议。

title: Least Cost Control of Agricultural Nutrient Contributions to the Gulf of Mexico Hypoxic Zone
abstract: In 2008, the hypoxic zone in the Gulf of Mexico, measuring 20 720 km2, was one of the two largest reported since measurement of the zone began in 1985. The extent of the hypoxic zone is related to nitrogen and phosphorous loadings originating on agricultural fields in the upper Midwest. This study combines the tools of evolutionary computation with a water quality model and cost data to develop a trade-off frontier for the Upper Mississippi River Basin specifying the least cost of achieving nutrient reductions and the location of the agricultural conservation practices needed. The frontier allows policymakers and stakeholders to explicitly see the trade-offs between cost and nutrient reductions. For example, the cost of reducing annual nitrate-N loadings by 30% is estimated to be US$1.4 billion/year, with a concomitant 36% reduction in P and the cost of reducing annual P loadings by 30% is estimated to be US$370 million/year, with a concomitant 9% reduction in nitrate-N.
abstract_zh: 2008年，墨西哥湾缺氧区的面积为20 720 km2，是自1985年开始测量以来所记录的两个最大面积之一。缺氧区的范围与美国中西部上游农田产生的氮和磷负荷有关。本研究将进化计算工具与水质模型及成本数据相结合，为上密西西比河流域构建了一条权衡前沿，用以说明实现养分减排的最低成本以及所需农业保护措施的位置。该前沿使决策者和利益相关者能够清楚地看到成本与养分减排之间的权衡。例如，将每年硝酸盐氮负荷减少30%的成本估计为每年14亿美元，同时磷减少36%；而将每年磷负荷减少30%的成本估计为每年3.7亿美元，同时硝酸盐氮减少9%。

title: Recreation Demand Using Physical Measures of Water Quality
Welfare Measures When Agents Can Learn: A Unifying Theory
Dynamic Willingness to Pay: An Empirical Specification and Test
The Cost of Cleaner Water: Assessing Agricultural Pollution Reduction at the Watershed Scale
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Nonpoint source pollution in intensively managed agricultural landscapes is of great concern to the general population, farmers and policymakers, as it impacts local water quality and can have large downstream effects, as in the case of hypoxia in the Gulf of Mexico. In this study, we outline a methodology to simultaneously assess economic costs and water quality benefits associated with the hypothetical placement of a broad set of conservation practices. The study, performed for the Iowa Department of Natural Resources, assesses thirteen major subbasins in Iowa by interfacing economic models with the Soil and Water Assessment Tool model. The conservation practices analyzed include land set-aside, terraces, grassed waterways, contouring, conservation tillage, and a simple nutrient reduction strategy. Annual costs range from $300 to $597 million. Predicted sediment, total phosphorus (P), and nitrate decreases range from six to 65 percent, 28 to 59 percent, and six to 20 percent, respectively, relative to the baseline.
abstract_zh: 在集约化管理的农业景观中，面源污染引起了普通民众、农民和政策制定者的广泛关注，因为它影响当地水质，并可能产生大范围的下游影响，墨西哥湾缺氧即是一例。在本研究中，我们概述了一种方法，用以同时评估与假设性地布设一系列广泛保护措施相关的经济成本和水质效益。该研究由爱荷华州自然资源部委托进行，通过将经济模型与土壤和水评估工具模型相结合，对爱荷华州13个主要子流域进行了评估。所分析的保护措施包括休耕、梯田、草水道、等高耕作、保护性耕作以及一项简单的养分减排策略。年成本范围为3亿至5.97亿美元。相对于基准情景，预测的泥沙、总磷和硝酸盐分别减少6%至65%、28%至59%和6%至20%。

title: The Status of Women in Environmental Economics
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article examines the status of women in the environmental economics profession in terms of their representation and impact. Three indicators are used to gauge the status of women in the profession. They are the representation of women in academia in the United States and Canada, the publication profiles of female environmental economists, and the representation of women in the roles of leadership within the professional association and lead journal of the profession. In a survey of schools with graduate programs in environmental economics, we find that female environmental economists are better represented in the faculty of noneconomics departments than in those of economics departments. A study of the publication profiles of women in the profession's main journal, the Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, indicates that women publish fewer articles on average than their male counterparts, and their papers receive fewer citations on average. Women are well represented in the leadership of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists and also in editorial positions at the Journal of Environment Economics and Management.
abstract_zh: 本文从代表性和影响力两个方面考察了女性在环境经济学专业中的地位。我们使用三项指标衡量女性在该专业中的地位：美国和加拿大学术界女性的代表性、女性环境经济学家的发表情况，以及女性在该专业专业协会和主要期刊中领导职位的代表性。在对设有环境经济学研究生项目的院校进行的一项调查中，我们发现女性环境经济学家在非经济学系的教师队伍中比在经济学系中具有更好的代表性。对该专业主要期刊《环境经济学与管理杂志》（Journal of Environmental Economics and Management）中女性发表情况的分析表明，女性平均发表的文章较少，且其论文获得的引用也较少。女性在环境与资源经济学家协会的领导层中具有良好的代表性，在《环境经济学与管理杂志》的编辑职位中也是如此。

title: Green Subsidies in Agriculture: Estimating the Adoption Costs of Conservation Tillage from Observed Behavior
The Consequences of Co-Benefits for the Efficient Design of Carbon Sequestration Programs
The Conservation Reserve Program in the Presence of a Working Land Alternative: Implications for Environmental Quality, Program Participation, and Income Transfer
abstract: The United States has invested large sums of resources in multiple conservation programs for agriculture over the past century. In this paper we focus on the impacts of program interactions. Specifically, using an integrated economic and bio-physical modeling framework, we consider the impacts of the presence of working land programs on a land retirement for an important agricultural regionthe Upper Mississippi River Basin (UMRB). Compared to a land retirement only program, we find that the presence of a working land program for conservation tillage results in significantly lower predicted signups for land retirement at a given rental rate. We also find that the presence of both a large working land and land retirement program can result in more environmental benefits and income transfers than a land retirement only program can achieve.
abstract_zh: 在过去的一个世纪里，美国在多项农业保护计划中投入了巨额资源。在本文中，我们关注计划之间相互作用的影响。具体而言，我们利用一个综合经济与生物物理建模框架，考察了在一个重要农业地区——上密西西比河流域（UMRB）——中，耕地可持续利用计划的存在对土地退耕计划的影响。与仅有土地退耕计划的情况相比，我们发现，在给定租金率下，保护性耕作的耕地可持续利用计划的存在会显著降低土地退耕计划的报名人数。我们还发现，同时存在大规模耕地可持续利用计划和土地退耕计划，相较于仅有土地退耕计划，可以带来更多的环境效益和收入转移。

The Efficiency of Sequestering Carbon in Agricultural Soils
abstract: Agricultural tillage practices are important human‐induced activities that can alter carbon emissions from agricultural soils and have the potential to contribute significantly to reductions in greenhouse gas emission (Lal et al., The Potential of U.S. Cropland, 1998). This research investigates the expected costs of sequestering carbon in agricultural soils under different subsidy and market‐based policies. Using detailed National Resources Inventory data, we estimate the probability that farmers adopt conservation tillage practices based on a variety of exogenous characteristics and profit from conventional practices. These estimates are used with physical models of carbon sequestration to estimate the subsidy costs of achieving increased carbon sequestration with alternative subsidy schemes.
abstract_zh: 农业耕作方式是人为活动的重要组成部分，它会改变农业土壤的碳排放，并有可能对温室气体减排作出显著贡献（Lal et al., The Potential of U.S. Cropland, 1998）。本研究考察了在不同补贴和市场化政策下，在农业土壤中固碳的预期成本。利用详细的国家资源调查（National Resources Inventory）数据，我们基于一系列外生特征以及农户从传统耕作中获得的利润，估计了农户采用保护性耕作措施的概率。随后，我们将这些估计与碳固存的物理模型相结合，以估算不同补贴方案下实现更多碳固存的补贴成本。

abstract: Agriculture and the environment are linked by a mutual reliance on scarce resources and prevalent market distortions. In this paper we examine the efficiency costs of policies that correct distortions in one sector while ignoring those in another. The dual distortions of an environmental externality and water subsidies are studied in the context of irrigated agriculture in California. The welfare costs associated with independent action by either a water agency or an environmental authority when that policy maker attempts to correct the respective market distortion without consideration of the distortion in the other market are estimated. Policies to correct the two distortions are found to be complementary. Under these conditions, the independent correction of either distortion improves welfare by at least $@@‐@@118 per acre. In most cases, the simultaneous adoption of various second‐best policies further reduces welfare losses associated with these distortions.
abstract_zh: 农业与环境通过对稀缺资源的共同依赖以及普遍存在的市场扭曲而相互联系。在本文中，我们考察了那些在纠正一个部门扭曲的同时忽视另一部门扭曲的政策所带来的效率成本。我们以加利福尼亚的灌溉农业为背景，研究了环境外部性和水资源补贴这两种双重扭曲。当水务机构或环境主管部门在纠正各自的市场扭曲时，未考虑另一市场中的扭曲，由此产生的福利成本得到了估算。纠正这两种扭曲的政策被发现是互补的。在这些条件下，任一扭曲的独立纠正每英亩至少可以提高福利118美元。在大多数情况下，同时采用各种次优政策可以进一步减少与这些扭曲相关的福利损失。

Emission Trading vs. Rigid Regulations in the Control of Vehicle Emissions
abstract: This paper presents the results of an empirical study of the cost savings associated with a marketable permit system for light-duty vehicles relative to the current system of uniform standards. The sensitivity of cost savings estimates to model specification are examined, including estimation approaches for obtaining cost functions, issues of the functional form of emission control cost functions, and choice of pollution variables included in the estimated cost functions. Additionally, the precision of point estimates of cost savings are explored using a simulation method for obtaining estimates of the standard errors of cost savings. (JEL Q25)
abstract_zh: 本文报告了一项实证研究的结果，该研究考察了轻型汽车可交易许可制度相对于现行统一标准所节约的成本。我们考察了成本节约估计对模型设定的敏感性，包括获取成本函数的估计方法、排放控制成本函数的函数形式问题，以及估计成本函数中所纳入的污染变量的选择。此外，我们利用模拟方法获得成本节约的标准误估计，以探讨成本节约点估计的精确度。（JEL Q25）

title: Environmental Benefits from Marketable Discharge Permits or an Ecological vs. an Economical View of Marketable Permits
An Assessment of the Empirical Magnitude of Option Values for Environmental Goods
An Emission Saved is an Emission Earned: An Empirical Study of Emission Banking
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: It is now widely agreed among economists that marketable permits are an efficient strategy for controlling environmental pollutants and an extensive literature on their properties has developed. In addition to cost considerations, banking may have important implications for emission levels. Unlike averaging and trading, which can be designed to result in the same level of emissions as a uniform standard, banking necessarily results in different emission levels from the base standard. To generate emission credits, manufacturers can choose from two forms of pollution abatement: they can reduce the amount of hydrocarbon emissions per vehicle by installing additional pollution abatement equipment, or they can change their vehicle sales mix and sell more vehicles with lower emission characteristics. A manufacturer that more than meets its average emission requirement in any year earns credits that can be sold to other firms or banked for future use or sale.
abstract_zh: 经济学家普遍认为，可交易许可是控制环境污染物的有效策略，关于其性质的大量文献也已发展起来。除成本因素外，排放存储（banking）可能对排放水平具有重要影响。与平均化和交易（可以设计为与统一标准产生相同排放水平）不同，排放存储必然导致与基准标准不同的排放水平。为产生排放信用，制造商可以在两种污染减排方式之间进行选择：一是通过安装额外的污染控制设备来减少每辆车的碳氢化合物排放，二是改变其车辆销售组合，多销售排放特性更低的车辆。在任一年份超额满足平均排放要求的制造商，可以获得信用，这些信用可以出售给其他企业，或存储起来供未来使用或出售。

title: Light-Duty Vehicle Exhaust Emission Control Cost Estimates Using a Part-Pricing Approach
venue: Journal of the Air and Waste Management Association
abstract: The substantial reductions in motor vehicle emissions that have occurred since the late 1960s have been accompanied by continuous increases in vehicle emission control costs, and cost increases or decreases due to changes in vehicle performance such as driveability, power, fuel economy, and vehicle maintenance. In this paper, a systematic approach has been developed to estimate emission control costs for motor vehicles. The approach accounts for all emission control parts installed on vehicles, and the costs of these emission parts are estimated through their prices. This paper does not estimate costs of the changes in vehicle performance and maintenance caused by emission control. Using information on emission control parts and their prices for new light-duty vehicles sold in California in 1990, per-vehicle control costs and total control costs for all new light-duty vehicles have been estimated. The cost to vehicle manufacturers per vehicle for emission control ranges from $220 to $1,460, depending on vehicle size and manufacturer. The sales-weighted average cost to manufacturers is $445 per vehicle. The total cost of emission control technology for 1990 light-duty vehicles sold in California is estimated to be about $698 million. The corresponding cost to consumers per vehicle for emission control ranges from $370 to $2,430, with a sales-weighted average of $748. The total cost for emission control of 1990 light-duty vehicles sold in California is about $1.2 billion to consumers. Pervehicle costs for vehicles sold elsewhere in the U.S. in 1990 are similar since emission standards were similar that year.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪60年代末以来，机动车排放大幅减少，与此同时，车辆排放控制成本持续上升，而由于驾驶性能、动力、燃油经济性和车辆维护等方面的变化，成本也有所增加或减少。本文开发了一套系统方法，用以估算机动车的排放控制成本。该方法涵盖了车辆上安装的所有排放控制部件，并通过这些部件的价格估算其成本。本文并未估算因排放控制而导致的车辆性能和维护变化的成本。利用1990年在加利福尼亚销售的新款轻型汽车的排放控制部件及其价格信息，我们估算了每辆车的控制成本以及所有新款轻型汽车的总控制成本。对于汽车制造商而言，每辆车的排放控制成本从220美元到1460美元不等，取决于车型大小和制造商。按销量加权的平均成本为每辆车445美元。估计1990年在加利福尼亚销售的轻型汽车的排放控制技术总成本约为6.98亿美元。对于消费者而言，每辆车的排放控制成本从370美元到2430美元不等，按销量加权的平均值为748美元。1990年在加利福尼亚销售的轻型汽车的排放控制总成本，对消费者而言约为12亿美元。1990年在美国其他地区销售车辆的每车成本与此相似，因为当年的排放标准基本一致。

title: Water Markets and Water Quality
abstract: In addition to improving the allocative efficiency of water use, water markets may reduce irrigation‐related water quality problems. This potential benefit is examined with a nonlinear programming model developed to simulate agricultural decision‐making in a drainage problem area in California's San Joaquin Valley. Results indicate that a 30% drainage goal is achievable through improvements in irrigation practices and changes in cropping patterns induced by a water market. Although water markets will not generally achieve a least‐cost solution, they may be a practical alternative to economically efficient, but informationally intensive, environmental policies such as Pigouvian taxes.
abstract_zh: 除了提高用水的配置效率外，水市场还可能减少与灌溉相关的水质问题。我们利用一个非线性规划模型考察了这一潜在效益，该模型用于模拟加利福尼亚圣华金谷一个排水问题区域的农业决策。结果表明，通过改善灌溉方式以及由水市场引发的种植结构调整，可以实现30%的排水目标。尽管水市场通常无法实现成本最低的解决方案，但对于在经济上有效却信息密集的环境政策（如庇古税）而言，它们可能是一种切实可行的替代方案。

title: Emission Permits under Monopoly
abstract: This paper studies the regulation of pollution emissions when one polluting firm is a monopolist in its output market and other polluting firms are competitive in their output markets. It is shown that an emissions permit system can generally support a second‐best allocation when the monopolistic firm has market power in the emission permit market. The second‐best permit regulation specifies a permit endowment for the monopolist such that the monopolist is a net supplier of permits in the equilibrium. Extensions to cases of multiple monopoly, monopsony, and oligopoly are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当一家污染企业在其产出市场中处于垄断地位，而其他污染企业在其产出市场中处于竞争地位时的污染排放监管问题。研究表明，当垄断企业在排放许可市场中具有市场势力时，排放许可制度通常可以支持次优配置。次优的许可监管规定为垄断企业分配一定的许可配额，使其在均衡状态下成为许可的净供给者。文中还讨论了多个垄断者、买方垄断和寡头垄断情形下的扩展。

title: The Reliability of Estimates of Environmental Benefits from Recreation Demand Models
abstract: Recreation demand models are commonly employed tools of economists interested in valuing improvements in environmental amenities. Despite their importance, little comparative work has been undertaken to examine the ability of the models to accurately estimate welfare changes. A simulation study designed to compare the reliability of estimated welfare measures (compensating variation and consumer surplus) from several commonly employed recreation demand models is presented. Results of the study indicate that choice of functional form and model specification are important determinants of the resulting estimates of benefits.
abstract_zh: 休闲需求模型是经济学家用以评估环境舒适度改善价值的常用工具。尽管这些模型十分重要，但关于其准确估计福利变化能力的比较性研究却很少。本文提出了一项模拟研究，旨在比较几种常用休闲需求模型所估计的福利指标（补偿变化和消费者剩余）的可靠性。研究结果表明，函数形式的选择和模型设定是决定效益估计结果的重要因素。

title: Valuing Environmental Quality Changes when Quality is a Weak Complement to a Set of Goods
A Simulation Approach to Comparing Multiple Site Recreation Demand Models Using Chesapeake Bay Survey Data
Estimating the Value of Water Quality Improvements in a Recreational Demand Framework
abstract: With the advent of Executive Order 12291, policymakers involved in water quality regulation are increasingly interested in assessing the benefits of their programs. Several methods for valuing water quality improvements using recreational demand models have been developed by economists, most of which depend on observing recreationists visiting an array of sites with varying water quality and costs of access. In this paper, three general types of models are described: systems of demands, discrete choice models, and the hedonic travel cost approach; the latter two models are demonstrated using a common data set on water quality and swimming behavior in the Boston area. The models are contrasted and their relative usefulness in answering policy questions explored.
abstract_zh: 随着第12291号行政命令的颁布，参与水质监管的政策制定者日益关注评估其项目的效益。经济学家已开发出几种利用休闲需求模型评估水质改善的方法，其中大多数依赖于观察休闲者前往水质和获取成本各异的一系列地点的行为。本文描述了三类基本模型：需求系统、离散选择模型和享乐式旅行成本方法；后两类模型使用波士顿地区关于水质和游泳行为的一个共同数据集进行了演示。文中对这些模型进行了对比，并探讨了它们在回答政策问题方面的相对有用性。
